Works</h3><p data-path-to-node="3">You don't need to understand the code, you just need to understand the <b data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="71">"Carrier Pigeon"</b> system:</p><ol start="1" data-path-to-node="4"><li><p data-path-to-node="4,0,0"><b data-path-to-node="4,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">The Trigger (Facebook):</b> A client from the UK messages your Page. It becomes a "persistent state"â€”a memory that doesn't depend on one single platform.</p></li></ol><hr data-path-to-node="5"><h3 data-path-to-node="6">Why this is a "Game Changer" for you:</h3><ul data-path-to-node="7"><li><p data-path-to-node="7,0,0"><b data-path-to-node="7,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">The "Anti-Heart Attack" Protocol:</b> You can check the Discord on your phone from your recliner. If you look at the Webhook settings in Discord right now, does that match <b data-path-to-node="2" data-index-in-node="196">exactly</b>?</p><p data-path-to-node="3"><b data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Here is the "Intelligent Dumbass" 60-second fix:</b></p><ol start="1" data-path-to-node="4"><li><p data-path-to-node="4,0,0"><b data-path-to-node="4,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">Delete that Webhook.</b> (Go to Settings &gt; Integrations &gt; Webhooks &gt; Click the red "Delete Webhook").</p></li><li><p data-path-to-node="4,1,0"><b data-path-to-node="4,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Create a brand new one.</b> (Don't change the name or the picture yet, just hit "New Webhook").</p></li><li><p data-path-to-node="4,2,0"><b data-path-to-node="4,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">Ensure it's set to <code data-path-to-node="4,2,0" data-index-in-node="19">#general</code>.</b></p></li><li><p data-path-to-node="4,3,0"><b data-path-to-node="4,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">Hit "Save Changes"</b> (This is the step most people missâ€”Discord won't activate the URL until you save).</p></li><li><p data-path-to-node="4,4,0"><b data-path-to-node="4,4,0" data-index-in-node="0">Copy the new URL.</b></p></li></ol><h3 data-path-to-node="5">Why we are doing this:</h3><p data-path-to-node="6">Sometimes Discord generates a URL that is "dead on arrival" if the server is brand new or the session timed out. A fresh URL resets the security handshake.</p><hr data-path-to-node="7"><h3 data-path-to-node="8">Once you have the New URL:</h3><p data-path-to-node="9">Don't even bother with Discohook. <b data-path-to-node="9" data-index-in-node="34">Just paste the new URL here.</b> Iâ€™ll try a "Raw Text" ping.
